headline: Bring Ecovacs cleaning into Home Assistant
intro: Ecovacs connects Deebot vacuums and supported Ecovacs mowers through the cloud. Set up an account in the Home Assistant flow, which checks authentication and the MQTT connection before loading device capabilities.
highlights: Choose cloud or self-hosted mode; self-hosted setup accepts REST and MQTT server URLs
Use vacuum and lawn mower controls alongside sensors, switches, buttons, selects, numbers, images, events, and binary sensors
Receive cloud-pushed device updates, with diagnostics including battery, network, error, cleaning statistics, and component lifespan where supported

flow.title: From account to device controls
stages: Enter account, country, and any self-hosted server URLs
Load supported device controls and sensors
